doc_summary: `native_screen_mouse_dragged_pre(screen, button, delta, modifiers, canceled)` runs before screen drag handlers for real nonzero pointer movements with a held button. The most recently pressed button is active until it releases; focus loss and splitscreen handoff clear it. Same screen exclusions and GLFW button/modifier encoding as the other screen input hooks. screen.mouse is the new GUI position; delta is movement in GUI pixels. Cancel skips screen drag handlers while retaining the new cursor position. Synthetic input and hover-only moves skip it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:screen_mouse_dragged@.
